title: Binance Earn: Dual Investment Supports XAUt
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Terms and conditions apply.  Fellow Binancians, Binance Earn is excited to announce that  Tether Gold (XAUt)  has been added to Dual Investment from  2026-04-23 09:00 (UTC) , users can now earn additional rewards via XAUt strategy. Please see the table below for more information, including details on the additional APR rewards. Supported Token XAUt Token Pairs XAUt-USDT, XAUt-USDC Subscription Tokens XAUt, USDT or USDC Target Price Multiple Target Prices available Settlement Date 08:00 (UTC) Each Workday APR 3.65% or more Tether Gold (XAUt) is a product developed to combine the benefits of physical and digital assets by allowing its holders to own physical gold in the form of a digital token. You may contact Circle using the following contact information: +33(1)59000130 and EEA-Customer-Support@circle.com.  Holders of USDC have a legal claim against Circle SAS as the EU issuer of USDC.
